research_rationale:
basis_pattern: original_plus_bounded_search. EO 11494 (signed 1969-11-13; 34 FR 18291; official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11494.txt, read in full) establishes the Presidential Citizens Medal. Identity: the heading of Executive Order 11494 establishing the Presidential Citizens Medal at 34 FR 18291, the title and the date agree with the register row. The dossier inventory held subsection (b) and a run of subsection (c) with sections 3 and 4 only, so I replaced it with six clauses (inventory override): sections 1, 2(a), 2(b), 2(c), 3 and 4. Own terms: no section has an end date or ending condition; the only own-text signal for the word terminate is section 4's statement that the Medal does not terminate any other medal, which ends nothing in this order. Later instruments: a search of every held order text for the number 11494 finds only the order's own Federal Register copy and the 1989 codification snapshot; the dossier chain has no event and its missing list has only the two standing current-law lines, which I read and rule out as bases because the basis of this claim is the held original text. The three selected machine searches (current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog) were read with their coverage notes, carry no coverage warning, and record 0 hits for the order. Limit stated plainly: the continuing predicate rests on the held original text and the bounded searches (U.S. Code through 2026-10-09); section 3's design duty is carried as continuing because no held source shows its performance.
